designs.title: Quickstart damped oscillation
designs.description: The main prototype target, using two integrators, one inverter, three coefficients, and a negating summer.

designs.title: Static inverter and coefficient
designs.description: A minimal patch showing coefficient scaling followed by sign inversion.

designs.title: Summer scaling and sign
designs.description: A negating summer combines a positive and a negative term.

designs.title: Multiplier product
designs.description: The multiplier computes a normalized four-quadrant product from two coefficient-scaled constants.

designs.title: Comparator switch
designs.description: The comparator selects one of two analog branches based on the sign of a + b.

designs.title: XIR summing-junction extension
designs.description: An XIR resistor network contributes an extra weighted term through a summer summing junction.

designs.title: Slow integrator ramp
designs.description: A single integrator demonstrates the slow-mode approximation and IC reset behavior.

designs.title: First Steps: Radioactive Decay
designs.description: Booklet Section 9.1 exponential decay patch with P1=N0, P2=lambda, and OUT X=N.

designs.title: First Steps: Mass-Spring-Damper System
designs.description: Booklet Section 9.2 underdamped suspension patch with P1=y0, P2=s, P3=D, P4=1/m, and OUT X=y.

designs.title: First Steps: Neuronal Bursting
designs.description: Runnable Section 9.4 scaled Hindmarsh-Rose neuronal bursting walkthrough using x10-weighted inputs, XIR/SJ, and SLOW.

designs.title: First Steps: Euler Spiral
designs.description: Booklet Section 9.5 Euler spiral patch with P1 tau ramp, P2/P5 scaling, and OUT X/Y x/y display.

designs.title: First Steps: Hunter/Prey Population Dynamics
designs.description: Booklet Section 9.6 Lotka-Volterra population patch with P1/P2 initial populations, P3-P6 alpha/beta/gamma/delta, and OUT X/Y phase display.

designs.title: First Steps: Lorenz Attractor
designs.description: Booklet Section 9.7 Lorenz chaotic attractor patch with P1-P6 coefficients, P7 initial x helper, and OUT X/Y/Z projection display.

designs.title: First Steps: Bouncing Ball
designs.description: First Steps Section 9.8 bouncing ball with OUT Y display inverted so rebounds appear at the lower edge.

designs.title: First Steps: Polynomial Generator
designs.description: Booklet Section 9.9 polynomial generator patch with x on OUT X, p(x) on OUT Y, and X/Y display routing.

designs.title: First Steps Helper: Adjustable Value -1 to +1
designs.description: Booklet Section 10.4 helper mapping one coefficient knob over the full -1..+1 machine-unit range.

designs.title: First Steps Helper: Maximum of Two Values
designs.description: Booklet Section 10.1 helper selecting the maximum of two adjustable values A and B.

designs.title: First Steps Helper: Minimum of Two Values
designs.description: Booklet Section 10.2 helper selecting the minimum of two adjustable values A and B.

designs.title: First Steps Helper: Absolute Value
designs.description: Booklet Section 10.3 helper selecting the absolute value of adjustable input A.

designs.title: First Steps Helper: Non-Negative Values Only
designs.description: Booklet Section 10.5 helper passing A when positive and zero otherwise.
